scope: isolated Cycle 10 hosted browser proof lane

observed_evidence.r5_recurrence: r5 retained provider variable retrieval before any approved-browser floor and retained Chromium fallback until this isolated mitigation branch

causal_timeline: 06:23:07Z isolated Railway container started healthy in hosted-staging mode.
06:23:23Z browser proof failed on a planner-surface assertion after authentication.
Post-run correlation showed the existing browser-floor policy protected direct GitHub-secret browser workflows but not provider-derived credentials.
The superseding r5 proof retained two provider-variable reads before any browser-floor check, proving the failure class could recur without a source-agnostic control.
root_cause: Browser credential safety was classified by credential source syntax rather than credential-bearing behavior. Authentication material fetched from a deployment provider could therefore be retrieved and injected into a browser session without first satisfying the approved browser security floor.
systemic_learning: Credential-bearing browser controls must be source-agnostic. Any path that can retrieve, materialize or inject authentication material into a browser must satisfy the same approved-browser floor before the credential becomes available to the proof process.
prevention: Fail closed on missing, unparsable or sub-floor approved Google Chrome before the first provider-variable retrieval.
Forbid fallback to unverified Chromium in credential-bearing hosted proofs.
Structurally prove floor -> first provider credential retrieval -> browser proof ordering.
Keep repository permissions read-only and execution repository-owner-only.
Run deterministic version-boundary and workflow-ordering regression fixtures on every relevant source change.
recovery_rule: Do not retrieve provider-derived staging authentication material for a browser proof unless an approved Google Chrome runner satisfies the recorded Linux security floor. Credential-free HTTP/static/provenance checks may continue independently.

metrics.prevention_coverage_change: direct-GitHub-secret browser paths only -> provider-derived credential browser path covered

open_uncertainty: The r4 product assertion exposed separate schedule-planner detection defects; r5 addresses those UX defects and they remain independent from this credential-browser containment.
The repository-wide credential registry in draft PR #58 should ultimately absorb provider-derived credential paths so credential governance is expressed in one source-agnostic policy.
safety_boundary: No production/customer deployment, workforce/payroll mutation, tenant mutation, credential rotation or security-control weakening performed by this mitigation.
